name: Citadel Zero
storyline:
The planet died long before you arrived. What's left is a wasteland of ruins
and rust — and one structure still standing: the Citadel.

You are the Architect. You don't fight; you build. From the last intact core,
you raise defensive towers across the ruins, guided by Sentinel-7, an ancient
machine intelligence that has been holding the perimeter alone for longer than
it can remember. It calls you Architect the way you'd name a tool you're not
sure will work.

The ruins are not empty. Mutated humanoid sentinels watch from the wreckage —
what remains of whoever built this place — and they come in waves, testing the
line. Beyond them, five regions each answer to something older: the Aether
Marshal, who claims the Citadel's breath; the Bone Sovereign; the Forge Lord;
the Quantum Archon, who is never quite where you aim.

And at the center of it all, in the ruin that was Citadel Zero itself, waits
something that shares your title.

The wasteland doesn't want to be defended. It wants to be understood.
summary: Defend the last citadel on a dying alien world. Summon a gacha collection of bio-engineered defense towers, forge a custom loadout, and conquer three modes, story-driven Chronicle, roguelite Contracts, and 1v1 PvP Ascension. Tower defense meets deck-building meta-progression.
